content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to CAPM Certification in Durham

steps_items.heading: Verify Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: CAPM requires only a secondary degree and completion of project management education—no work experience necessary. This makes the credential ideal for Durham professionals entering project management roles across life sciences, healthcare, higher education, and technology sectors. Confirm you meet PMI's educational requirements before enrolling.

steps_items.heading: Complete 23 Hours of Education
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led boot-camp-style course. Designed for working professionals, our intensive format delivers all required contact hours efficiently, allowing you to balance certification training with your current role while preparing thoroughly for exam success.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After course completion, apply directly to PMI and pay the associated exam fee. Granite PM Academy will guide you through the application process, ensuring your credentials are submitted accurately and your exam eligibility is confirmed before your test date.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Test for CAPM
steps_items.text: Access Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources and practice assessments to build confidence in CAPM content. Schedule your proctored exam when ready, and leverage our instructor support to address final questions and solidify your readiness.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your Credential
steps_items.text: CAPM credentials renew every three years through professional development units (PDUs). Plan your PDU activities early—whether through training, conference attendance, or volunteer project leadership—to keep your certification active and demonstrate ongoing commitment to project management excellence.

fq_items.question: Do I need project management experience to take the CAPM?
fq_items.answer: No prior PM experience is required. The CAPM only requires secondary education (high school diploma or equivalent) and 23 contact hours of project management education — which our course fulfills.

fq_items.question: Is the CAPM a good starting credential for {city} professionals?
fq_items.answer: Yes. The CAPM is one of the most recognized entry-level PM credentials and is highly regarded across industries in {city_state}. It demonstrates PM knowledge to employers even before you have years of experience.

fq_items.question: How does the CAPM differ from the PMP?
fq_items.answer: The PMP requires 36–60 months of project leadership experience; the CAPM does not. Many professionals earn the CAPM early in their career, gain experience, then pursue the PMP.

fq_items.question: Is this training delivered online?
fq_items.answer: Yes. Our CAPM training is fully live-virtual — no travel required. {city} students attend via video conference from wherever they are.

fq_items.question: Is CAPM certification worth it for project managers in Durham?
fq_items.answer: Yes, especially in Durham's dominant sectors. Healthcare systems, pharmaceutical firms, and life sciences employers in the Research Triangle Park region frequently list PMP or CAPM as preferred or required credentials for project management roles. CAPM positions you competitively for advancement at organizations like Duke University Health System, IQVIA, and Biogen, where certified professionals often command stronger advancement and compensation prospects than non-certified peers.

fq_items.question: Which Durham employers actively hire CAPM or PMP certified professionals?
fq_items.answer: Major Durham employers including Duke University Health System, pharmaceutical firms such as GlaxoSmithKline and Biogen, technology companies like IBM and Cisco Systems, and government agencies view PMP and CAPM credentials as meaningful differentiators. Life sciences and healthcare organizations concentrated here particularly value certified practitioners for clinical trial management, infrastructure projects, and IT implementations. Blue Cross Blue Shield of North Carolina and Fidelity Investments also regularly seek certified project managers.

fq_items.question: When should Durham project managers pursue CAPM certification given the local job market?

If you are early in your career or transitioning into project management at a Research Triangle Park employer, completing CAPM certification before or shortly after starting can accelerate recognition and career momentum. The credential aligns closely with how Durham's largest employers evaluate internal promotion.
